name: kanban
description: A kanban side pane: Active (Backlog, Human, Claude) and Inactive (Done, Cancelled, Suspended) sections over GitHub Projects or local .kanban/ cards.

backend.title: Card backend
backend.description: Where cards live. auto: GitHub when CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md names a repo and project board, or else when git and gh find a GitHub Project linked to the origin remote's repo (no config needed; press the board name in the toolbar to change it), and gh is signed in; otherwise local .kanban/ files. github: GitHub only, a failing check is shown instead of falling back. local: always .kanban/ files.

claudeLimit.title: Claude limit
claudeLimit.description: How many cards Claude works on at once. Cards moved to Claude beyond that wait in a queue and start, in order, as cards leave Claude. 0 means no limit.
